1: const { DatabaseSync } = require('node:sqlite');
2: const fs = require('node:fs');
3: const path = require('node:path');
4: 
5: const DB = path.join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/opencode/opencode.db');
6: const WORKTREE = '/Users/rayhan/Desktop/Code projects/Openglimpse';
7: const OUT = '/Users/rayhan/Desktop/Code projects/Openglimpse/ai/rayhan/ai-logs';
8: 
9: const db = new DatabaseSync(DB, { readOnly: true });
10: 
11: if (!fs.existsSync(OUT)) fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
12: 
13: function safe(s) {
14:   return String(s || '').replace(/\t/g, ' ');
15: }
16: function sanitizeName(title) {
17:   return title.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '').slice(0, 60) || 'session';
18: }
19: 
20: const sessions = db.prepare(`
21:   SELECT s.id, s.title, s.parent_id, s.agent, s.model, s.cost,
22:          s.tokens_input, s.tokens_output, s.tokens_reasoning, s.tokens_cache_read,
23:          datetime(s.time_created/1000,'unixepoch') AS created,
24:          datetime(s.time_updated/1000,'unixepoch') AS updated,
25:          s.time_created AS t
26:   FROM session s JOIN project p ON p.id = s.project_id
27:   WHERE p.worktree = ? AND s.parent_id IS NULL
28:   ORDER BY s.time_created
29: `).all(WORKTREE);
30: 
31: function getMessages(sessionId) {
32:   return db.prepare(`
33:     SELECT m.id, m.time_created AS t, m.data AS mdata
34:     FROM message m WHERE m.session_id = ? ORDER BY m.time_created, m.id
35:   `).all(sessionId);
36: }
37: 
38: function getParts(messageId) {
39:   return db.prepare(`
40:     SELECT p.time_created, p.data FROM part p WHERE p.message_id = ? ORDER BY p.time_created, p.id
41:   `).all(messageId);
42: }
43: 
44: function clean(text) {
45:   return String(text ?? '').replace(/\u0000/g, '');
46: }
47: 
48: function renderMessage(msg) {
49:   const parts = getParts(msg.id);
50:   const out = [];
51:   let parsedMsg = {};
52:   try { parsedMsg = JSON.parse(msg.mdata); } catch {}
53:   const role = parsedMsg.role || (parts.some((p) => { try { return JSON.parse(p.data).type === 'text'; } catch { return false; } }) ? 'assistant' : 'user');
54:   for (const p of parts) {
55:     let d;
56:     try { d = JSON.parse(p.data); } catch { continue; }
57:     if (d.type === 'reasoning') continue;
58:     if (d.type === 'text') {
59:       out.push(clean(d.text));
60:     } else if (d.type === 'tool') {
61:       const call = d.state?.input || {};
62:       const keys = ['command', 'filePath', 'pattern', 'url'];
63:       const firstKey = keys.find((k) => k in call);
64:       out.push(`[tool:${d.tool}] ${firstKey ? `${firstKey}: ${String(call[firstKey]).slice(0, 300)}` : ''}`);
65:     } else if (d.type === 'error') {
66:       out.push(`[error] ${clean(d.error || d.message || '')}`);
67:     }
68:   }
69:   if (msg.role === 'user' && msg.mdata) {
70:     try {
71:       const md = JSON.parse(msg.mdata);
72:       if (md.summary?.diffs?.length) out.push(`[diff stats: ${md.summary.diffs.length} files, ${md.summary.additions}+/${md.summary.deletions}-]`);
73:     } catch {}
74:   }
75:   return { role, text: out.filter(Boolean) };
76: }
77: 
78: let fileIdx = 0;
79: for (const s of sessions) {
80:   fileIdx++;
81:   const messages = getMessages(s.id);
82:   const blocks = [];
83:   for (const m of messages) {
84:     const { role, text } = renderMessage(m);
85:     const label = role === 'user' ? '**User:**' : '**Assistant:**';
86:     const body = text.join('\n\n');
87:     if (!body) continue;
88:     const header = `${label} (${new Date(m.t).toISOString()})`;
89:     blocks.push(`${header}\n\n${body}`);
90:   }
91:   const content = [
92:     `# ${s.title}`,
93:     '',
94:     `- **Session ID:** \`${s.id}\``,
95:     `- **Model:** ${s.model}`,
96:     `- **Created:** ${s.created}  **Updated:** ${s.updated}`,
97:     `- **Tokens:** ${s.tokens_input} in / ${s.tokens_output} out / ${s.tokens_reasoning} reasoning / ${s.tokens_cache_read} cache-read | **Cost:** $${Number(s.cost).toFixed(4)}`,
98:     '',
99:     '---',
100:     '',
101:     ...blocks,
102:     '',
103:   ].join('\n');
104: 
105:   const fname = `${String(fileIdx).padStart(3, '0')}_${sanitizeName(s.title)}.md`;
106:   fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, fname), content);
107:   console.log('wrote', fname, `(${blocks.length} message blocks)`);
108: }
109: 
110: console.log(`\nTotal: ${sessions.length} sessions extracted to ${OUT}`);

(End of file - total 110 lines)

49: ## High-Level Plan
50: 
51: Implement an offline-first sync engine with **8 segments**. Client gets a Dexie.js local DB (`entities` + `pendingChanges` tables). An `offlineApi.js` layer wraps every existing API call — when online it fetches+caches, when offline it reads/writes locally. A single server `POST /sync` endpoint applies batched changes and returns full state. A `useSync` hook triggers `pushAndPull()` on reconnect. Chat is **disabled** entirely when offline (no queuing).

53: ---

55: ## Detailed Plan with Code Snippets
56: 
57: ### Segment 1 — Install dependency
58: ```bash
59: npm install dexie
60: ```
61: That's it; `crypto.randomUUID()` is used instead of a `uuid` lib.
62: 
63: ### Segment 2 — `db/localDB.js`
64: No adversarial complexity — straightforward Dexie schema with two tables, indexed on `serverId`, `type`, `status`.
65: 
66: **Potentially tricky:** The `entities` table needs to store arbitrary domain fields alongside the fixed ones. Dexie handles this natively — you just put extra properties on the object.
67: 
68: ### Segment 3 — `sync/offlineMutations.js` + `sync/syncEngine.js`
69: 
70: **Adversarial part:** `offlineMutations.js` must modify `entities` AND append to `pendingChanges` in a single Dexie transaction. The `pendingChanges` record is a single row (`id: 'current'`) whose `changes[]` array accumulates. If a notification (online event) fires mid-transaction, the batch could be incomplete. Use Dexie's `transaction('rw', ...)` API:
71: 
72: ```js
73: // offlineMutations.js — key snippet
74: import { db } from '../db/localDB';
75: 
76: export async function createLocal(type, data) {
77:   const localId = crypto.randomUUID();
78:   await db.transaction('rw', db.entities, db.pendingChanges, async () => {
79:     await db.entities.add({ localId, serverId: null, type, status: 'pending', ...data });
80:     const pc = await db.pendingChanges.get('current') || { id: 'current', changes: [], timestamp: 0 };
81:     pc.changes.push({ entityType: type, op: 'create', data: { localId, ...data } });
82:     pc.timestamp = Date.now();
83:     await db.pendingChanges.put(pc);
84:   });
85:   return localId;
86: }
87: ```
88: 
89: **`syncEngine.js` — key snippet:**
90: ```js
91: export async function pushAndPull() {
92:   const pc = await db.pendingChanges.get('current');
93:   if (!pc || pc.changes.length === 0) return;
94: 
95:   const res = await fetch('/sync', {
96:     method: 'POST',
97:     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
98:     body: JSON.stringify({ lastSyncTimestamp: pc.timestamp, changes: pc.changes }),
99:   });
100:   const serverState = await res.json();
101: 
102:   await db.transaction('rw', db.entities, db.pendingChanges, async () => {
103:     await db.entities.clear();
104:     for (const type of ['programme', 'route', 'delegate', 'attendance', 'readyToDepart']) {
105:       for (const record of serverState[type] || []) {
106:         await db.entities.add({ localId: crypto.randomUUID(), serverId: record.id, type, status: 'synced', ...record });
107:       }
108:     }
109:     await db.pendingChanges.delete('current');
110:   });
111: }
112: ```

122: import { db } from '../db/localDB';
123: import { createLocal, updateLocal, deleteLocal } from '../sync/offlineMutations';

134:       await db.entities.bulkAdd(toCache);
135:       return data;

660: 
661: | Concern | How it's handled |
662: |---|---|
663: | Adding a new entity type | One new entry in `SYNCED_ROUTES` |
664: | Adding a new endpoint for an existing type | One new export + route entry if the URL pattern is new |
665: | Auth / face / QR / chat | Not in `SYNCED_ROUTES` → never intercepted, throws if offline |
666: | Complex shapes (attendance, summary) | `complex: true` → cached as raw blob, not decomposed |
667: | Attendance upsert | `upsert: true` → calls `offline.upsertLocal()` by programmeId+delegateId |
668: | Batch attendance offline | Detects `body.records`, queues each as individual upsert |
669: | URL query params (e.g. `?archived=true`) | Stripped before matching; offline reads ignore them (returns all) |
670: | `requestWithAuth` | Completely separate function, never touched |
671: | Optimistic offline writes | Returns a fake success shape so calling code doesn't crash |
672: | Cache invalidation | Replaced entirely by full sync + on each online GET |

674: The tradeoff vs the per-wrapper `offlineApi.js` approach: offline reads of complex shapes (`attendance`, `summary`) return the last cached blob rather than a real-time reconstructed view. Offline writes queue but don't eagerly update those blobs — the next sync replaces them.
